name: Wild & Wired OS
legal_line: Based on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Canonical.
source: frontend-design/design_handoff_wild_wired_os_shell (Claude Design, adopted 2026-08-21). Tokens mirror _ds/.../tokens/*.css; do not edit values here without editing the handoff record in DECISIONS.md.
voice: Reassurance is structural, not cheerful: 'Nothing is written to disk.'
No em dashes, no exclamation marks, no emoji; mono sigils ($ # :: -> !! block) where a glyph is needed
Numerals always; dates 'November 14, 2026' in prose, 'nov 14 2026' in mono
Banned words: weird, hacker, cyber, wizard, guru, power user, just, simply, obviously

well.role: deepest well: terminal blocks, panel bg, footers, sponsor board

structure.role: borders, rules, separators, icon chrome. NEVER text

mint.role: THE accent: links, primary fill, active, focus. 6.94:1 on base

logo_plate.role: light plate under every logo appearance

plate_ink.role: placeholder text inside a light plate

textures.grid: 24px monospace grid, grid_line alpha. Hero and section fields, wallpaper only.
textures.scanline: 1px line every 4px, scanline alpha. Terminal panels and poster fields.
textures.rule: Neither texture in window backgrounds. No gradients anywhere. No red, amber, or blue.

ui.why: humanist body at 340 on dark (Qt gets static 400; art keeps 340)

mono.why: full system member: labels, metadata, commands. Labels tracked .14em uppercase

script.status: LICENSE UNCONFIRMED. Not vendored, not rendered. Fallback: plated raster lockup.

circuit.usage: the word 'WIRED' + short machine labels, 15px floor
circuit.status: LICENSE UNCONFIRMED. Not vendored, not rendered. Fallback: JetBrains Mono tracked uppercase.

logo.plate_rule: Every logo appearance sits on a logo_plate fill, 6px radius, plate_hairline stroke, 20x28px padding at 1x. The artwork contains navy and dies on the dark base bare.
logo.icon_note: Raster badge unreadable below 32px; the 16/22px mint glyph is Phase 2 artwork (missing).

sponsor_board.reflow: Past a tier maximum the generator drops to the quiet strip layout and logs a warning.

direction.note: Panel geometry, wallpaper composition, and window decoration wait on the pick. Everything in this file is direction-independent.
